T: Everybody love everybody. Everybody eat everything.
D: Jackie Moon owns, coaches and plays for the Flint Tropics, a 1976 basketball team fighting to survive the merger.
P: Serve the snacks at the Tropics' tip-off.
S: Flint, Michigan, home of the Tropics
Hot dogs in soft buns topped with a dry, finely ground spiced beef coney sauce, mustard and diced onion, the Flint way.
the Flint Tropics and their very tropical uniforms

King prawns crumbed in coconut and panko, fried until crunchy, with a sticky mango, lime and chilli dipping sauce. Peel 600g green king prawns, leaving tails on. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 60g desiccated coconut mixed with 60g panko. Fry in oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and drain. Simmer the flesh of 1 mango with 3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, the juice of 1 lime and 1 chopped red chilli for 3 minutes, then blitz smooth. Serve the prawns hot with the sauce.
M: the owner, coach and power forward
Sticky barbecue pork ribs basted until glossy, with buttered corn and coleslaw, a big seventies cookout plate.
W: Light orange butter sponge layered with whipped vanilla mascarpone cream, finished with orange glaze and zest, the colour of a Tropics jersey. Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 200g butter and 200g caster sugar, add 4 eggs one at a time and the zest of 2 oranges, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 60ml orange juice. Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake 25 minutes. Cool. Whip 250g mascarpone, 200ml cream, 2 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla. Sandwich and top the cakes with the cream and drizzle over 100g icing sugar mixed with 2 tbsp orange juice.
K: Hot espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and brown sugar syrup into a thick crema, strained into chilled coupes with an orange twist. Chill 4 coupes. Pull 4 shots of espresso and cool 5 minutes. For each drink, shake 45ml vodka, 30ml coffee liqueur, 30ml espresso and 10ml brown sugar syrup with lots of ice for 15 seconds until foamy. Strain into the glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top. For non-drinkers, shake the espresso with syrup, milk and ice instead.

s.note: Flint, Michigan, home of the Tropics
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince until very fine and dry, then add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and 60ml water and cook 10 minutes. Grill 8 frankfurts and put in 8 hot dog buns with mustard, the coney sauce and diced onion.

m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with salt, pepper and smoked paprika, wrap in foil and bake at 160C for 2 hours. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill until sticky. Serve with 4 buttered corn cobs and 1 bag coleslaw mixed with mayonnaise.
